quests.instruction: Make an indirect request at work.
quests.hint: Use the question about your early finish to raise a favor, and offer something back.
quests.explanation: Requests sound reasonable when you offer to compensate. The colleague or manager can say yes without feeling used.
quests.partnerDialogue: You're packing up early today. Everything okay?
quests.sampleAnswer: Fine, actually. I was hoping I could leave early on Friday and work extra on Monday.
acceptedSynonyms: fine, actually. i was hoping i could leave early on friday and work extra on monday
all fine. i wanted to ask if i could leave at four on friday. i'll make up the time
yes, thanks. would it be possible to finish early on friday? i'll catch up afterwards
all fine, i wanted to ask if i could leave at four on friday
smartReplies: All fine. I wanted to ask if I could leave at four on Friday. I'll make up the time.
Fine, actually. I was hoping I could leave early on Friday and work extra on Monday.
Yes, thanks. Would it be possible to finish early on Friday? I'll catch up afterwards.
quests.correctAnswer: Fine, actually. I was hoping I could leave early on Friday and work extra on Monday.

quests.instruction: Ask a favor from hotel staff.
quests.hint: Seize the opening to ask for something extra, with your reason.
quests.explanation: "Would it be possible...?" is more flexible than "Can I...?" and makes a no easier to accept.
quests.partnerDialogue: Was there anything else you needed?
quests.sampleAnswer: One thing: is there any chance of a later checkout tomorrow? Our flight is at seven.
acceptedSynonyms: one thing: is there any chance of a later checkout tomorrow? our flight is at seven
actually, yes. would it be possible to have a late checkout? my flight isn't until the evening
yes, could we possibly stay in the room until three? our flight's late
smartReplies: One thing: is there any chance of a later checkout tomorrow? Our flight is at seven.
Actually, yes. Would it be possible to have a late checkout? My flight isn't until the evening.
Yes, could we possibly stay in the room until three? Our flight's late.
quests.correctAnswer: One thing: is there any chance of a later checkout tomorrow? Our flight is at seven.

quests.hint: Explain what you need without sounding lazy.

quests.correctAnswer: I hoped you might suggest some books on my topic. I can't find much.

Just so I'm clear, you mean after the meeting, right?

quests.hint: Restate the key points in one short sentence.

In short, north users lose access overnight, maybe not all night. Correct?
Let me check: overnight downtime, north region only, and it could end early?
quests.correctAnswer: In short, north users lose access overnight, maybe not all night. Correct?

quests.hint: Show you understand their trade-off.

it sounds like you like the work, but the extra travel is not worth the money
smartReplies: So you like the job, but the commute and the small raise make it doubtful?
If I understand, the role is great, but the trade-offs are big.
It sounds like you like the work, but the extra travel isn't worth the money.
quests.correctAnswer: It sounds like you like the work, but the extra travel isn't worth the money.

quests.instruction: Confirm the rule in plain terms.

So caged animals are usually okay, but not cats or dogs?
Do you mean a hamster would be fine, but a dog or cat wouldn't?
quests.correctAnswer: So caged animals are usually okay, but not cats or dogs?

Tell me what you enjoy. For history, I'd say the old capital. For beaches, the coast.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell me what you enjoy. For history, I'd say the old capital. For beaches, the coast.

quests.hint: Show you understand the frustration, then suggest one practical step.

quests.correctAnswer: That sounds exhausting. Have you tried getting the changes in writing?
